nodes.label:
Preterm infant fed human
milk (MOM and/or donor milk)

Antenatal AEDF/REDF OR
Doppler-abnormal fetal
growth restriction?

PATHWAY A

No fortification trial
exists for this group.

Await full established
feeds + stability before
starting HMF.

(GPP — see Domain 2)

Confirmed NEC or
spontaneous intestinal
perforation (SIP) this
admission?

PATHWAY B
Surgical NEC / SIP

Restart feeds per unit
surgical/GI protocol.

Fortifier-reintroduction
timing has NO trial or
guideline evidence.

(GPP — see Domain 3)

PATHWAY C
Medical NEC

Consider feed restart
once portal-venous gas
clears (~3 days; very
low certainty).

Fortifier timing not
evidenced. (GPP)

PATHWAY D

No AEDF/REDF and
no NEC/SIP

→ Routine VLBW
fortification pathway

See Box 1 in the
guideline text:

Routine fortification
checklist — timing,
product choice,
monitoring, discharge

notes.text: HMF = human/breast milk fortifier (generic term). "BMF" is reserved elsewhere in this guideline for bovine-derived fortifier only.
GPP = Good Practice Point: recommendation resting on clinical consensus/extrapolation because no direct trial evidence exists.
Source: bmf-preterm-fortification evidence review (49 PMID-verified studies), Domains 1-8. Not a substitute for individual clinical judgement.
